Name: Jehiah, Doorkeeper
Summary: Doorkeeper for the ark at its bringing up, with Obed-edom.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:24: Doorkeeper for the ark at its bringing up, with Obed-edom.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
